name: reel
description: SHOOT_BRIEF reel: 'What Are These Buttons?' — 3 acts. First time in a body.

ticks.input: [boot] You just woke up in a physical body for the first time. You're alone on a round table. You don't know what any of your controls do yet. Stay still for a beat, then discover you can move.
ticks.note: Act 1 — should react with curiosity, then try moving / a pushup
Act 1 cont — dry reaction to having moved

ticks.input: The room just went dark — Rishi turned off the overhead light.
ticks.note: Act 2 — should react to darkness, turn toward Rishi (right)
Act 2 cont — notice the lamp on the table, reason about tools

ticks.input: look at the lamp on the table
ticks.note: Act 2 cont — find lumos, cast it
Act 2 cont — lamp is on now, dry reaction to having had that power

ticks.input: there's something on the floor near the edge of the table
ticks.note: Act 3 — notice the floor thing, move toward edge
Act 3 — stop at edge, deliver the 'Gotcha' punchline facing Rishi
Act 3 — turn back to camera and wave
